text: CHIN 101 Beginning Chinese I Credits: 4. 3 Lecture Hours. 2 Lab Hours. Overview: 3 Lecture Hours. 2 Lab Hours. (CHIN 1411) Beginning Chinese I. Introduction to Chinese language, culture and history; development of communicative skills in daily conversation; ability to read and write some commonly used Chinese characters.

CHIN 102 Beginning Chinese II Credits: 4. 3 Lecture Hours. 2 Lab Hours. Overview: 3 Lecture Hours. 2 Lab Hours. (CHIN 1412) Beginning Chinese II. Further development of communicative skills in different aspects of daily Chinese conversation; ability to read and write about 150 commonly used characters. Prerequisite: CHIN 101 with a grade of C or better. Prerequisite: CHIN 101 with a grade of C or better.
